work: Beit Elohim, commentary on Perek Shira
locator: Printed pp322–323; betelo28.pdf pages20–21 (zero-based19–20); horse lemma bottom left p322 continues top right p323
edition: Warsaw, Isaac Goldman; title imprint uses chronogram אין זה כי אם בית אלהים. Daat catalogue 1882/date and author conflict with original title; date not independently resolved here.
quote: העבדים אין להם לב לתבוע מאדוניהם שום דבר אפילו מזונותיהם אלא שתולין עיניהם אל יד אדוניהם
context: Printed Perek Shira appendix, horse follows locust commentary and precedes small clean animal. Commentary continues across page boundary.
interpretation: Printed original independently confirms PSH001: servants hesitate to request even food; plural servants/masters share a station and are ashamed before one another; maid serves mistress at home. Eyes toward God anticipate assured mercy whereas human masters may not give. This horse lemma does not explicitly invoke a supernatural horse or a named spiritual world.
limitations: Independent verification of PSH001 transcription, not a second historical edition.
Author attribution visually verified in separate original title https://www.daat.ac.il/daat/vl/betelo/betelo01.pdf page1.
Title says Venice של״ו; online JewishBooks edition list says שנ״ו. Preserve discrepancy rather than resolve from transcription.
